Ask Home Assistant aboard

What myCar\'s parrot can\'t do itself goes to the voice assistant set up in Home Assistant (Settings > Voice assistants there): Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, a model at home, or Home Assistant\'s own, which also runs the house. With the phone locked, it answers in place of the phone\'s parrot. Only those words go to your Home Assistant, as text.

Play the sound aboard over Bluetooth?

Android treats shanties sent through myCar like sharing your screen, so it asks every voyage. Over Bluetooth it never asks, if your ship plays the phone\'s shanties that way. You can change this later in Rigging.
Or keep it and sink the question for good: plug the phone into a computer with USB debugging on, and run this once.
Sound aboard needs the microphone permission

Android lets an app send other apps\' sound to the car only if it has the microphone permission. It\'s turned off for myCar, so the shanties play on the phone. Turn it on under Permissions, then Microphone.

Parrot: live words

The ship\'s parrot turns speech into text on this phone, and nothing you say leaves it - except, with Home Assistant set up, what myCar can\'t do itself, sent to your Home Assistant as text. It needs two models, about %1$d MB together, downloaded once. This one writes your words as you speak, in English; in another language it only hears when you stop.
Parrot: final words
When you stop talking, this model reads the whole phrase again. It nets the names and places the live model lets slip.
